We report the average probability of responses being positive as a measurement of the style intensity (SI). The content relevance is evaluated by BLEU. ... we also evaluate the diversity by Dist‑k.

The content relevance is evaluated by BLEU. Since it may correlate weakly with human judgments of quality in a single reference setting , we employ the expanded responses in multi-reference DailyDialog test set  as references to alleviate the problem. Meanwhile, we evaluate the diversity by Dist-k , which is the number of distinct k-grams normalized by the total number of words of responses.

We randomly sample 200 messages from the test set of C to conduct the human evaluation from two aspects: style intensity and content relevance. Each aspect is independently evaluated by five Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers whose approval rate is greater than 95%, and the number of approved is greater than 500.
guideline: Workers are asked to give a preference of which one is better in style intensity and content relevance (ties permitted).
